accessibility_issue_vimeo_password_prote: The video is password-protected, so viewers are asked for a Vimeo password instead of seeing the video. Set "Who can watch this?" to "Hide from Vimeo".
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_disabled: Embedding is turned off for this video, so it cannot play here at all. Set "Where can this be embedded?" to "Specific domains".
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_whitelis: Embedding is limited to specific domains, but no domain is allowed yet. Add the domain this app is served from.
Plays only on these domains: {domains}. Visitors on any other domain see an error.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_unlisted_needs: Unlisted videos can only be embedded through their private link hash, which this app does not store. Set "Who can watch this?" to "Hide from Vimeo" instead.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_video_not_foun: This video no longer exists in the connected Vimeo account.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_unavaila: Vimeo did not return any embed code for this video.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_no_api_token: No Vimeo API token is configured, so only a basic embed check could run.
accessibility_issue_unknown_provider: This media uses a provider the app does not know.
accessibility_issue_check_failed: The check could not be completed. See the server log for details.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_open_privacy: Open the video on Vimeo and go to Settings → Privacy.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_hide_from_vime: Set "Who can watch this?" to "Hide from Vimeo" so the access token stays the only way in.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_embed_specific: Set "Where can this be embedded?" to "Specific domains".
accessibility_setup_vimeo_add_domain: Add the domain this app runs on. Add your local development origin too if you test there.
accessibility_setup_vimeo_recheck: Save on Vimeo, then run the playback check again here.
accessibility_issue_vimeo_embed_whitelis: Plays only on these domains: {domains}. This app is served from {host}, so visitors here see an error. Add {host} on Vimeo.
groups_empty: No groups yet. Create a group to hand out one token for several media.
